title: Artifact Request v1
description: Structural schema for an explicit ArtifactRequest. Maps to the real backend/jewelmind/api/schemas.py request models (ExportStepRequest, ExportStlRequest, ExportJsonRequest, SpecificationRequest) — one HTTP endpoint per artifact type today, not a single unified request object. See docs/bible/08-alchemist/177-artifact-request-model.md.

includeStoneReference.description: CURRENT for STEP and STL (api/schemas.py::ExportStepRequest.includeStoneReference, ExportStlRequest.includeStoneReference).

meshTolerance.description: CURRENT for STL only (ExportStlRequest.meshTolerance) — no equivalent override exists for PREVIEW_MESH generation.

required.description: Whether this artifact's failure should block overall compilation success — see docs/bible/08-alchemist/173-partial-compilation-policy.md. Not a real field anywhere in current code; every current export request is independently issued and independently succeeds or fails, with no concept of one artifact being 'required' relative to another.
